name: paperclip-mcp
description: MCP server for the Paperclip AI agent orchestration platform. Manage issues, agents, goals, approvals, and costs via natural language.

PAPERCLIP_API_KEY.description: Agent API key — generate in Paperclip UI: Settings → API Keys → New Key.

PAPERCLIP_COMPANY_ID.description: Company UUID — visible in the Paperclip UI URL: /companies/{uuid}.

PAPERCLIP_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Paperclip API. Default: http://localhost:3100/api

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token required by HTTP transports (streamable-http/sse). The server refuses to start over HTTP without it; not used by stdio. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32.

MCP_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS base URL of this server (e.g. https://paperclip-mcp.example.com). Required for Claude.ai web OAuth support. When set, enables OAuth 2.0 alongside the existing static bearer token. OAuth client_id: paperclip-mcp-client; client_secret: same as MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.
